# muxt check reports malformed route template names with the same positioned
# error muxt generate prints, instead of listing the template as unused.

! muxt check
cmpenv stderr want-err.txt

-- want-err.txt --
  GET / Home(reqest)
             ^^^^^^
$WORK/template.gohtml:1:22: unknown argument reqest; did you mean request?

Route templates with no generated handler; run muxt generate to wire them up:
  - $WORK/template.gohtml:1:32: "GET / Home(reqest)"
Error: fail: 2 errors
-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Home(reqest)"}}ok{{end}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"net/http"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type T struct{}

func (T) Home(_ *http.Request) string { return "" }
